candidates.name: Sensor Model Language (SensorML)
verified_facts: SensorML defines processes and processing components associated with measurement and post-measurement transformation of observations.
Its scope includes sensors, actuators and computational processes used before or after measurement.
semantic_limits: A SensorML process description improves interoperability but does not by itself prove sensor calibration, source vertical accuracy or parcel-specific elevation correctness.

candidates.name: Sensor Observation Service (SOS)
verified_facts: SOS defines a web-service interface for querying observations, sensor metadata and representations of observed features.
The standard also defines operations for sensor registration and insertion of observations.
semantic_limits: Service availability and standards-compliant observation access do not validate the accuracy, calibration, datum or parcel relevance of the returned observations.
